name: Synthetic Finance Platform Detection Validation
objectives: Validate identity and endpoint telemetry coverage for approved adversary behaviors
Measure whether detections generate actionable analyst evidence
Verify remediation and retest workflow without impacting production services

techniques.name: Valid Accounts
techniques.tactic: Defense Evasion / Persistence / Privilege Escalation / Initial Access
techniques.objective: Validate detections for abnormal use of synthetic test identities
techniques.detection_goal: Correlate successful authentication with unusual device, location, and privilege context

techniques.name: PowerShell
techniques.objective: Validate benign scripted execution telemetry in the isolated lab
techniques.detection_goal: Confirm process, command-line, parent-child, and script-block telemetry are available to defenders

techniques.name: Remote Desktop Protocol
techniques.detection_goal: Correlate logon type, source host, target host, account, and session telemetry

techniques.name: Impair Defenses
techniques.objective: Document a prohibited high-risk behavior for tabletop discussion only
techniques.detection_goal: Review whether control-tamper alerts and change-management evidence would be available

safety_controls.name: Named authorization
safety_controls.description: Written approval covering scope, dates, owners and objectives

safety_controls.name: Deconfliction channel
safety_controls.description: Dedicated security operations contact and escalation route

safety_controls.name: Stop authority
safety_controls.description: Security operations and business owner may immediately halt activity

safety_controls.name: Synthetic identities and data
safety_controls.description: Only synthetic accounts and non-sensitive test data are used

safety_controls.name: Evidence handling
safety_controls.description: Evidence is minimized, access controlled and retained only for the exercise
